ClauseWeightCarry:
∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (n : ℕ) (hn : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.length ≤ n),
    ((List.range (n+1)).map (fun i => (φ.filter (fun c => c.length = i)).length)).foldr
      (fun count next => count + next / 2) 0 = 0 ↔
      (φ.map (fun c => (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ ^ c.length)).sum < 1
MeasuredVariableRestriction:
∀ (mode : Option Bool),
    ∃ restrict : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) restrict ∧
      ∀ (i : ℕ) (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF),
        restrict ((i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true],PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) =
          PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ((φ.filter (fun c => mode.elim true (fun b => decide ((i,b) ∉ c)))).map
            (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ≠ i))))
MeasuredClauseMap:
∀ (f : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool)
    (hf : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) f),
    ∃ collect : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) collect ∧
      ∀ (arg : List Bool) (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF),
        collect (arg,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = φ.flatMap (fun c => f (arg,PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c))
MeasuredWidthClassCount:
∃ count : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) count ∧
      ∀ (width : List Bool) (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF),
        count (width,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) =
          List.replicate ((φ.filter (fun c => c.length = width.length)).length) true
MeasuredClauseWeight:
∃ test : List Bool → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) Computability.encodeBool test ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF,
        test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = true ↔ (φ.map (fun c => (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ ^ c.length)).sum < 1
MeasuredLowWeightSearch:
∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF,
        (∀ c ∈ φ, (c.map Prod.fst).Nodup) →
        (φ.map (fun c => (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ ^ c.length)).sum < 1 →
        ∃ xs : List ℕ,
          search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = xs.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true]) ∧
          (∀ x ∈ xs, ∃ c ∈ φ, ∃ l ∈ c, l.1 = x) ∧
          PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval (fun x => decide (x ∈ xs)) φ = true
MeasuredDistinctClauseVariables:
∃ test : List Bool → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) Computability.encodeBool test ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = true ↔ ∀ c ∈ φ, (c.map Prod.fst).Nodup
ExactLowWeightSAT:
{x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      (∀ c ∈ φ, (c.map Prod.fst).Nodup) ∧
      (φ.map (fun c => (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ ^ c.length)).sum < 1 ∧ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
MeasuredFirstClause:
∃ split : List Bool → List Bool × List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) PEqualNP.Library.encodePair split ∧
      split [] = ([],[]) ∧
      ∀ (c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause) (tail : List Bool),
        split (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c ++ tail) = (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c, tail)
MeasuredClauseLiteralCount:
∃ count : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) count ∧
      ∀ c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause, count (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c) = List.replicate c.length true
